Metadata.title: Portals Design
Metadata.description: Organize, present, and deliver branding projects through professional client portals.

Landing.description: Portals Design turns your brand systems into polished client portals where you can present the work, organize assets, and deliver every file in one place.

details.title: A better handoff is part of the design.
details.description: Portals Design gives brand designers one considered space to present the thinking, organize the system, and deliver every final asset without breaking the experience.

benefits.title: Tell the story behind the system
benefits.description: Guide clients through the strategy, visual language, and decisions that make the identity work.

benefits.title: Give every asset a clear home
benefits.description: Structure logos, guidelines, colors, typography, and exports in a portal clients can understand.

benefits.title: Make the final moment feel designed
benefits.description: Turn delivery into a polished extension of the brand instead of one last folder download.

plans.title: Choose the scope for each portal.
plans.description: Start free and unlock Premium only for the portals that need more capacity.

free.name: Free
free.description: For presenting smaller projects and getting started without friction.
features: 1 section each for files, typography, colors, and galleries

premium.name: Premium
premium.description: For fuller handoffs and portals with a distinct identity.
features: Up to 2 files and typography sections
